title: James Gunn and Peter Safran are leaving their jobs running DC Studios
dek: The two people who rebooted DC's films and shows are stepping down as its heads. A Marvel veteran takes over, and fans are already arguing about what happens to the planned slate.
what: On Monday, 9 November 2026, The Hollywood Reporter, Variety and TheWrap reported that James Gunn and Peter Safran will step down as co-heads of DC Studios. TheWrap reports that the change takes effect on 1 December. Jeremy Latcham, who worked at Marvel Studios in its early years, becomes president and chief creative officer.

TheWrap reports that Latcham will report to Dana Goldberg and Josh Greenstein, co-chairs of Skydance Motion Picture Group. It also reports that Gunn and Safran say they will return full time to creative work, including post-production on the Superman sequel "Man of Tomorrow". Trade outlets reported a joint statement from the two saying they were eager to see what Latcham brings to DC's next chapter.
Variety's headline describes the two as "out". The statement quoted by TheWrap describes a choice to return to creative work. I could not find a source that says which of these is the full picture.

Posts on X add a second claim: that the plan under Gunn included Batman in "The Brave and the Bold" in 2028 and a "Justice League" film later. One post attributes that to a reporter. I could not confirm it outside X, so it is not treated as established here.
why: Gunn's DC slate was the main rival to Marvel's, and many fans had followed it closely since 2022. A sudden change of leadership, with a Marvel name in charge, reads to many people as a story about the whole slate and not only about two jobs.
next: The change is due to take effect on 1 December. Which announced projects keep going has not been stated in the reports I read.
